facts.fact: The World Bank's World Development Indicators list 2008 as Burundi's latest population census.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Troisième Enquête Démographique et de Santé 2016-2017 as Burundi's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
facts.system: Troisième Enquête Démographique et de Santé 2016-2017

facts.fact: The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Core Welfare Indicator Questionnaire Survey (CWIQ) of 2014 as the source of Burundi's most recent income and expenditure data.
